messages:
alex: Kicking off model catalog enable for redwood-open-3b-v2 in the eu-west change window. Starting canary at 5% traffic now. deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for model=redwood-open-3b-v2 target=5% status=IN_PROGRESS
maya: Thanks — can we confirm fallback ordering and pin list before we scale? quick check on regen quality sets too.
jeremy: Confirming fallback order should be v2 -> v1 -> redwood-quant-3b. If v2 fails, traffic should fall back to v1, then quant. Also request we pin v1 for 24h to avoid drift during the rollout.
sre-oncall: Observability note: watch p50/p95 tokens and tail latency. If p95 > 1200ms for 2 consecutive 1m windows, trigger rollback. I’ll keep an eye.
pat: Added an eval job for the regen QA set, ETA ~12m. Will post results.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics: 5% ready. throughput=240rps latency_p50=210ms latency_p95=520ms errors=0.
maya: Looks ok so far. Two asks: (1) add a graceful fallback TTL of 30s for KV cache compatibility; (2) ensure quant variant has lower priority but is eligible for cold-fallback only.
alex: Agreed on TTL. Jeremy — can you add a pin for v1 and update the catalog priority JSON?
jeremy: Pushing catalog patch now. Snippet:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-open-3b-v2",
  "fallbacks": ["redwood-open-3b-v1", "redwood-quant-3b"],
  "priority": ["v2", "v1", "quant"],
  "kv_cache_ttl_seconds": 30,
  "pin_duration_hours": 24
}
```
deploy-bot: Catalog update applied. New priority ladder in effect. canary=5% -> scales to 20% in 10m if metrics stable.
sre-oncall: FYI eval job shows minor perplexity delta +0.8% on regen set. Acceptable but keep monitoring for hallucination regressions.
pat: Regen QA passed smoke checks. No notable safety regressions in the sample.
maya: Proceeding to scale to 20%. alex, do we want to annotate the release notes for internal ops?
alex: Yes — add note: "enable redwood-open-3b-v2; fallback ladder v2→v1→quant; 24h pin on v1; KV cache TTL 30s; rollback guard p95>1200ms." devex-bot: @channel release note drafted at docs/releases/3b-v2-enable.md
sre-oncall: 6m in at 20%: p95=610ms, errors=0. No anomalies.
deploy-bot: Traffic now at 20%. Next scale to 50% in 20m if stable.
jeremy: Quick ops option: if we see memory pressure, we can route lower-priority traffic to quant using routing policy `priority-ladder-cold-fallback`. Command: `/route set-priority --model redwood-open-3b-v2 --policy cold-fallback`
maya: Noted. If p95 spikes beyond threshold, I want automatic revert to v1 rather than immediate rollback to remove customer-visible regression. So fallback first, then rollback if fallback fails.
pat: Regen QA full pass complete. No new safety flags.
sre-oncall: Alert — p95 just hit 1250ms for two 1m windows at 2002003500.
maya: Triggering controlled rollback plan: step 1 fallback traffic to v1 immediately, step 2 if errors persist for 5m, full rollback.
deploy-bot: Applying fallback re-prioritization: active-> v1. Routing change applied.
alex: Monitoring. Jeremy, please confirm pin still holds.
jeremy: Pin remains. Rolling rollback only if fallback doesn't stabilize within 5m.
sre-oncall: After fallback, p95 dropped to 480ms. Errors stabilized. Rolling back not needed.
maya: Good call. Let's hold at 20% for another 30m, then revisit metrics and decide full rollout or staged rollback.
alex: Closing loop — document the incident in release notes and flag for postmortem if we need deeper perf tuning. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
